summary: EWOS has taken action that positively impacts BioMar, likely through a merger or strategic partnership. The move strengthens BioMar's standing in the aquaculture feed sector. Translated from Norwegian title 'EWOS Lifts BioMar'—referring to EWOS (a major aquaculture feed company) acquiring or partnering with BioMar Group, a subsidiary of Schouw & Co headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark.
title: EWOS løfter BioMar
